# rLungVolume

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

Utilities for calculating and summarizing lung volume metrics from pulmonary function test data. Use this package to derive common measures, organize results for analysis, and prepare values for visualization or reporting workflows.

## Installation

You can install the development version of rLungVolume from GitHub:

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("JBarsotti/rLungVolume")
```

## Example

Load the package and call the bundled greeting helper:

``` r
library(rLungVolume)

hello_pkg()
#> [1] "Hello from rLungVolume!"
```
